title: Feedback on Visuals for 1700s Sailing/Trading Game?
author: VanillaMammoth1937
selftext:
I've been working on a game set in the mid-1700s where you play as a merchant and sail to ports around the world to trade goods. You will also be able buy/upgrade ships and weapons, hire crew, craft better goods, gamble, and more.

Most of the assets, except for the world map and a few icons, are AI-generated. I wanted to get some feedback on the visuals and whether the assets look like AI slop. The game looks good to my eye, but I know I'm biased. I do know the ship looks clunky while sailing and I already plan to improve that. Also, the 6 panels I show at the end are not implemented yet, I just wanted to show them to get feedback.

I would also appreciate any other general game comments. This is my first time making a game, so I'm new to this world.

[Main Game](https://reddit.com/link/1sbpqa7/video/e68xserth1tg1/player)

[Character Creation](https://reddit.com/link/1sbpqa7/video/tgl31vkyh1tg1/player)

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body:
super clean, just one feedback: the parchment ui for the character creator looks perfect. to make it seamless, I think if you had the background choices presented in smaller font with 2x5 instead of 1x10 scroll (so it all fits without scrolling/cutting off) it would be clean.

https://preview.redd.it/ew1mc56ul1tg1.png?width=889&format=png&auto=webp&s=08d49ae3ffd0dabcd6035791eff4c1c5be6e342b

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback! I actually had tried your idea of showing all of the backgrounds without using a scrollview, but it didn't look great because some of the names are pretty long so it's hard to fit in. I will definitely experiment around with some layouts.

I actually didn't think of New Horizons for this game, it was more inspired by Sid Meier's Pirates and other sailing/trading games.

comments.author: UneqMrCrow
comments.body: I think you should use historical flags

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body: I had considered that, but I thought the historical flags would be unrecognizable to players. I will try that and get some feedback from others on whether they understand what the flags are. Thanks for the idea

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body: I'll post more updates to this sub as I continue to develop. Thanks!

comments.author: august-breezy-blue
comments.body: Looks easy on the eyes and love your font choice!  Did you use AI to help with your layout, too?

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body: Thank you, I didn't use AI for the layout. I mostly used Unity's built-in Layout Groups to make things look nice

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: Looks good, but the background at the Captain Creation definitely looks AI. The compasses look off.

comments.author: ND_Jamoose
comments.body: Looks very good imo. Where did you get the world map from?

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body: Thank you, the world map is from NASA's Blue Marble photoset
